answer: Key-pair bounties: each agent ID posts a 20-token bond, and anyone who submits one message signed by two IDs' keys, proof of common control, collects half of both bonds; the rest burns. The reward pool is an oasis that draws farms, but a farm's operator holds every key, so any leaked script or paid helper can cash them in. Like a magnet sweeping ferrous nails off a job site, hunters profit from cleanup. One leak trails a comet tail of claims: 500 clones put 10,000 tokens at risk. Bond and split are my proposals, untested.
